{{Short description|Norwegian politician (born 1963)}}
[[File:Kristin Vinje - 2013-08-10 at 13-12-12.jpg|thumb]]
'''Kristin Vinje''' (born Kristin Sørby; 10 June 1963) is a Norwegian [[chemist]] and politician for the [[Conservative Party (Norway)|Conservative Party]]. She served as  city commissioner for finance in Oslo from 2009 to 2013 when she was elected to the [[Parliament of Norway]].

Vinje was awarded a [[Ph.D.]] in chemistry by the [[University of Oslo]] in 1994. She worked as a researcher at [[SINTEF]] from 1996 to 2002 and worked for the Ministry of Trade and Industry (Norway) from 2002 to 2005. She was vice-director of [[Simula Research Laboratory]] from 2005 to 2007 and director of Simula School of Research and Innovation from 2007 to 2009.<ref>[http://www.kristinvinje.no/om-meg/ Høye ambisjoner for forskning Oslo Høyres 4. kandidat til Stortingsvalget 2013] Kristinvinje.no. Retrieved 23 September 2013 {{in lang|no}}</ref> She works as Chief Executive at the Norwegian Agency for Quality Assurance in Education and serves as a board member of the [[European Association for Quality Assurance in Higher Education|ENQA]] since 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Structure • ENQA |url=https://www.enqa.eu/structure/ |access-date=2025-05-17 |website=ENQA |language=en-US}}</ref>

She is married and has four children.<ref>Kristin Tufte Haga (29 August 2013): [http://dittoslo.no/nordre-aker/nyheter-nordre-aker/hun-dromte-om-a-bli-oljeminister-1.8042831 Hun drømte om å bli oljeminister] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131016074553/http://dittoslo.no/nordre-aker/nyheter-nordre-aker/hun-dromte-om-a-bli-oljeminister-1.8042831 |date=2013-10-16 }} Dittoslo.no. Retrieved 23 September 2013 {{in lang|no}}</ref>
